title: Arquiteto De Soluções - Com Foco Em Ia
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: No Grupo Fleury, acreditamos que o futuro da saúde será cada vez mais data-driven, inteligente e digital. Estamos construindo um ecossistema tecnológico que integra dados, inteligência artificial, automação e plataformas digitais, com o objetivo de transformar a jornada de cuidado em saúde. Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções, que será responsável por projetar e evoluir soluções tecnológicas escaláveis que utilizem IA, dados e plataformas cloud para gerar impacto real no negócio. Se você é apaixonado por arquitetura de sistemas, IA generativa, plataformas de dados e cloud computing, essa oportunidade é para você. Principais desafios da posição: - Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, incluindo aplicações de Machine Learning, IA Generativa e automação inteligente.
- Projetar arquiteturas modernas baseadas em cloud-native architecture, microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
- Desenvolver soluções que integrem plataformas de dados, modelos de IA, APIs e sistemas corporativos.
- Atuar no desenho de soluções com Large Language Models (LLMs), GenAI, AI Agents e automação baseada em IA.
- Definir padrões de arquitetura para soluções que utilizem plataformas de IA em nuvem.
- Apoiar squads de engenharia no desenvolvimento de soluções com IA, dados e plataformas digitais.
- Garantir que as soluções atendam requisitos de segurança, governança de dados, escalabilidade e observabilidade.
- Avaliar novas tecnologias e frameworks emergentes no ecossistema de AI, Data e Cloud Architecture. Tecnologias e plataformas com as quais você irá trabalhar: A arquitetura da companhia envolve um ecossistema moderno de tecnologias, incluindo: Cloud e Plataformas de IA AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, EKS, Aurora, API Gateway) Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, AKS, Data Factory, Synapse) Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE) Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning LLMs e GenAI (OpenAI, Claude, Llama, Gemini) Frameworks de IA (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face) AI Agents e arquiteturas multi-agent RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) MLOps e LLMOps Arquitetura de Software e Integração Microservices e APIs Event-driven architecture Kafka, RabbitMQ e streaming de dados API Management Engenharia e Plataforma Kubernetes / OpenShift CI/CD e DevOps Observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible) Buscamos profissionais com: - Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
- Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Software ou Arquiteto de Plataforma.
- Experiência em arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
- Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning ou IA Generativa.
- Experiência com arquitetura de dados, APIs e integração de sistemas.
- Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e cloud-native.
- Conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD e observabilidade.
- Inglês intermediário ou avançado. Diferenciais importantes: - Experiência com GenAI, AI Agents ou plataformas de IA corporativa.
- Experiência com arquitetura de dados e data platforms (Data Lake, Data Mesh ou Lakehouse).
- Experiência em ambientes regulados como healthcare, financeiro ou telecom.
- Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital baseada em IA. Nosso jeito de trabalhar, buscamos pessoas que: - Estimulem a troca de conhecimento e colaboração entre times.
- Invistam continuamente em aprendizado e evolução técnica.
- Conectem tecnologia e negócio para gerar impacto real.
- Busquem inovação contínua e melhoria das soluções. Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office) Carga Horária: 220h Mês - 44h Semanais Escala: Segunda á sexta - feira. Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48 Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada! Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
- Acesso à plataformaOrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
- Licença maternidadee paternidade estendidas;
- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida. Proteção e estabilidade: - Previdência privada;
- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida. Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Auxílio-Creche;
- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços. Desenvolvimento e educação: - Plataforma de ensino;
- Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições. Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória. Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas. Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. title: Sr. Ai Engineer
description:

You’re the person who makes AI products real.The role:They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.What you’ll do:Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.Tech you’ll work with:Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.Js, ReactMonorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure ADCI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.What they’re looking for:Must-havesAI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.Js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents;
you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.Nice-to-haves:Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analyticsSnowflake / SQL analytics experienceExperience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UXAzure cloud platform experienceLLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptimeHow our partner works:Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.Documentation as code. CLAUDE.Md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.Benefits:A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.Two weeks of paid vacation per year.10 paid days for local holidays.*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Sr. Ai Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)Please upload your CV Resume in English.Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USDAlong with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.The role:They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.What you’ll do:- Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.- Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.- Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.- Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.- Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.- Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.- Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.- Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.Tech you’ll work with:- Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.Js, React- Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.- AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)- Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.- Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0- You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.- Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD- CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.What they’re looking for:Must-haves- AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.- You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.- Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.Js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.- Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.- Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.- AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents;
you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.- AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.- Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.Nice-to-haves:- Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics- Snowflake / SQL analytics experience- Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX- Azure cloud platform experience- LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptimeHow our partner works:Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.- Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.- Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.- Documentation as code. CLAUDE.Md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.- Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.Benefits:- A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.- The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.- Two weeks of paid vacation per year.- 10 paid days for local holidays.*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Capacidade analítica,autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade. Você pode se destacar se: Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;

LLM-based downstream use cases Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.Md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.Tech you’ll work with:- Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.Js, React- Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.- AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)- Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.- Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0- You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.- Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD- CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.What they’re looking for:Must-haves- AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.- You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.- Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.Js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.- Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.- Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.- AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents;
you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.- AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.- Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.Nice-to-haves:- Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics- Snowflake / SQL analytics experience- Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX- Azure cloud platform experience- LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptimeHow our partner works:Their development workflow is AI-native. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.- Documentation as code. CLAUDE.Md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.- Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Back End Developer
description: About You You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.Js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions. You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.Js. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience. Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations. Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios. Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data. Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services. Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines. Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred). Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.G., SSRF). Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact. Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus). Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Take ownership of the Node.Js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase. Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations. Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance. Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness. Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment. Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments. Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes. Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms. Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes. Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability. Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes. Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development. Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Node.Js backend development. Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects. Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL. Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations. Advanced English proficiency. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Back End Developer
description: About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Sustentação, Suporte e Performance- Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva.- Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app.4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua- Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas.- Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código.O que buscamosPessoas que:- Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção.- Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile.- Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos.- Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance.- Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean).- Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação.- Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando /"overengineering/".- Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante.- Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios.- Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção.- Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Back-End Technical Lead
description: At OSF Digital, we are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Back-End Technical Lead to drive the design, development, and optimization of scalable server-side solutions. Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture. Proficiency with version control tools such as Git. Strong understanding of server-side logic, scalability, and performance optimization. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Fluency in English is required. Benefits: Discover OSF’s benefits and programs!

Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design - Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage - Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS) - Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory - Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso - Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises - Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup Azure Networking – Conceitos principais - Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP - Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall - Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute - Private Endpoints e service endpoints - Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure ✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações - Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking - Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Integração com Log Analytics Workspace - Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL) - Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura - Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais ✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios - Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware) - Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade - Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos - Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde ✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade - Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking - Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito - Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC - Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags - Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas Automação e integração (desejável): - Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep - Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps - Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) - Runbooks operacionais padronizados ✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente - Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica - Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros ✅ Perfil de Experiência - Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure - Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes - About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. title: Vfx- Subject Matter Expert
description:

If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.Why join this project?This is an opportunity to licence your existing assets and to apply your expertise in VFX design on a flexible, ad hoc basis, in order to help improve AI systems for video generation with better controllability for creators.Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participantJoining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. title: Back End Developer
description: About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams.The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key SkillsVisionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic.Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values:Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFERTrust that you are proficient at what you do. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. You won't stand alone.Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSIONAt Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Business Intelligence Developer (Remote)
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados. A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação). O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS). Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT). Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes. Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados. Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados. Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures). Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis). Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault). Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar). Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).
